fuente.titulo: Holy See: ‘No algorithm can make war morally acceptable’

titular: Holy See urges ban on autonomous weapons
bajada: At Geneva talks, Vatican says no algorithm can justify war's moral choices
caption: At the Seventh Review Conference of the Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons in Geneva, the Holy See submitted a position paper calling for a moratorium on lethal autonomous weapons systems and a legally binding international treaty. The document insists that decisions over life and death in warfare must remain in human hands, not be delegated to machines. Source: Vatican News, Nov 20, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: A conference hall with national flags and empty delegate seats at dusk; a dove-shaped paper document rests on a podium in the upper right, left and center space open
